title: QuadraticFloor: a Lean 4 formalization of quadratic floor sums and the trace of a quartic Bernoulli number
description: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the floor-sum results of J. S. Farland, Quadratic Floor Sums, Class Numbers, and the Trace of a Quartic Bernoulli Number. For an odd prime p, the alternating floor sum S_{A,B,C}(p) of (-1)^floor((An^2+Bn+C)/p) is reduced to a Legendre-symbol sum over an arithmetic progression, and for odd A and admissible (B, C) it is expressed through first Bernoulli numbers of odd characters modulo 8Ap with weights conj(psi(B))^2 (the square-class decomposition). At A = 5 the difference S_{5,3,0}(p) - S_{5,1,0}(p) is the real part of the first Bernoulli number of a quartic character of conductor 40p, an even integer with an explicit residue modulo 4. The cases A = 1, 3 are proved in Bernoulli form and the monic shifts are classified. No sorry, no native_decide; standard axioms only.
